criteria.note: Tier A meets the 2-year account-age bar; Tier B meets every other bar but has a younger account, and rides at half weight.

style_filter.note: Institution-style wallets (desk-scale tickets or >$1M weather notional) are removed. copy_trader mirrors BUYs and holds to resolution, so wallets that sell out of most positions ride at half weight rather than being treated as buy-and-hold.

shortlist.method: Ranked on trades that clear COPY_MIN_LEADER_NOTIONAL and on the PnL of those trades specifically, not on headline lifetime PnL. A wallet whose edge lives in sub-$50 dust produces no signal this bot can act on.

not_selected.ShyGuy1: most copyable volume (2,397) but only 2.2% ROI on them -- too thin to survive our slippage
not_selected.HenryTheAtmoPhD: 7.1% ROI but 0.52 copyable buys/day -- roughly one signal every two days
not_selected.387411007415611814: 2-year account, but only 59 copyable trades ever (0.51/day)
not_selected.securebet: 2-year account, 0.22 copyable buys/day and a 53% sell share
not_selected.Legend-: 15.1% headline ROI is entirely in $3 dust: 24 copyable trades ever, and they LOST $73
